title_en: Wangwang Squad: Adventure Bay Loses Power
source_file: 旺旺队：冒险湾停电了（2-10岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] nickelodeon
PAW
PATROL
汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书
冒险湾停电了
美国尼克儿童频道／著
安东尼／译
天地出版社｜TIANDI PRESS

[P2] 在一个刮大风的下午，狗狗们正聚集在凯蒂的宠物乐园里，
计划着给阿奇举办一场生日惊喜派对。

“必须得有彩带！”灰灰说。

“嗯，还得有生日蛋糕！”凯蒂补充道。

“但是有谁能缠住阿奇，
不让他发现我们在秘密地准备
派对呢？”天天问。

小砾说：“毛毛！他很擅长做保密工作，不是吗？”

[P3] 毛毛带着阿奇来到了公园里。
“风太大了！我们还是离开这里去找其他伙伴吧！”阿奇说道。
毛毛紧张地回答：“不要！我的意思是……这里多好玩呀！而且我
也没有什么秘密要隐瞒……”
突然，风变得更猛了，
一下子把狗狗们从秋千上
刮倒在了地面上。
砰！

[P4] 宠物乐园里，所有的狗狗
都在热火朝天地为派对做准备。
突然，灯全都熄灭了！

灰灰看着窗外，惊讶地说：
“街上的灯也都灭了。这是怎么
回事呢？”

莱德看了一下他的平板电脑，说：“如
果是全城停电，那一定是杰克山上的风力发
电机出了问题。”

“没有电，我们就不能放音乐了！”天
天叫道。

“也没有灯光了！我们就没法为阿奇举
办生日派对了！”小砾沮丧地说。

[P5] 莱德说：“毛毛，你用云梯把我送上塔台。”
毛毛马上架起了他的云梯，让莱德爬上了塔台。
莱德观察着远程监控画面。“原来是一架风车的叶片坏掉了，难怪会停电。”
“不会的！汪汪队，马上到塔台集合！”莱德说着，握紧了平板电脑。
狗狗们一起冲向塔台，但是那里也停电了，电梯没法使用。

[P6] “狗狗们，我们遇到了紧急情况。灰灰，我需要你在卡车上找到能修复风车叶片的工具。”莱德说。
“毛毛，我们要用你的云梯爬上风车。”
“阿奇，交通信号灯肯定也坏了，我们需要你用警笛和扩音器来指挥交通！”
汪汪队——
来帮忙！
莱德悄悄地说：“天天、小砾和路马，你们留下来准备派对。”狗狗们都开心地点头。
“马上出发！”其他汪汪队员喊道。

[P7] 天天、小砾和路马留在了塔台。
天天说道：“咱们现在就去准备派对吧！”
路马问：“没有电，我们能做些什么呢？”
“我们在黑暗中也能举办派对！”小砾说道。
天天欢呼着：“没错！我们就给阿奇准备一场最特别的乌漆墨黑生日派对！”

[P8] 在中央大街上，信号灯没有电不能
使用，整个街道堵得水泄不通！

古威市长很担忧：“天越来越黑了，
我们却连马路都过不了了。”

这时，阿奇赶来了，他立刻用扩音器开始指挥交通。

阿奇喊道：“大家注意！所有行人走这边，快！所有车辆走那边，停！”

所有的车辆都按照阿奇的指挥行驶。不一会儿，交通就变得顺畅起来，
行人也能安全穿过马路了。

[P9] 莱德、毛毛和灰灰赶到风车旁。
“我们得让发电机尽快恢复运行，这样阿奇的生日派对才能顺利进行。”莱德一边说，一边把损坏的风车叶片取了下来。
灰灰说：“我们可以用路马的旧冲浪板来修补它！旧物别丢掉，还有大用处！”
毛毛架起云梯，让灰灰爬了上去。灰灰把旧冲浪板安在风车上，随着风力加大，风车又开始重新转动起来了。
“我们做到了！”莱德、毛毛和灰灰欢呼着。

[P10] 宠物乐园里，当灯光重新亮起来的时候，狗狗们正在欢乐地玩耍。
“莱德和狗狗们成功啦！”
凯蒂开心地欢呼。
“但是来不及烘焙生日蛋糕了啊！”
天天很担忧。
“我有一个主意！”凯蒂神秘地说。

[P11] 中央大街上的交通信号灯也重新亮起来了。
“莱德和狗狗们成功了！大家可以看着信号灯安全地穿过马路了。”阿奇说道。
“谢谢你，阿奇！”大街上的人们说道。

就在这时，莱德打来了电话：“阿奇，计划有变，我们需要你立刻赶往凯蒂家。”
“立刻出发！”阿奇回答。
莱德告诉天天：“阿奇正在赶来的路上，我们也在往回走。”
天天叫道：“太好了！惊喜派对已经准备好了！”

[P12] 当阿奇赶往凯蒂的宠物乐园时，屋内一片漆黑。
“喂，有人吗？”阿奇喊道。
“哟吼！”所有人都欢呼着从桌子后面跳了出来，“生日快乐，阿奇！”
“你们摸黑为我准备了一场生日派对？”阿奇很激动。
“要惊喜，就找汪汪队！”莱德大笑着说。

[P13] 凯蒂说道：“我们没办法为你准备真正的生日蛋糕，但我希望你能喜欢这个狗狗饼干蛋糕！”
莱德说：“这是阿奇的生日，但你们都是最棒的狗狗！咱们开始庆祝吧！”
阿奇吹灭了蜡烛，所有狗狗都欢呼了起来，他们开心地吃起了这个特别的生日蛋糕。
full_text_en:
[P1] nickelodeon
PAW
PATROL
Paw Patrol: Children's Safety Rescue Storybook
Adventure Bay Has Lost Power
By Nickelodeon Children's Channel
Translated by Anthony
Tiandi Press

[P2] On a windy afternoon, the puppies gathered at Katie's Pet Park, 
planning a birthday surprise party for Chase.

"We must have streamers!" said Rocky.

"Yeah, and we need a birthday cake!" added Katie.

"But who can hold Chase back, 
so he doesn't find out we're secretly preparing 
the party?" asked Sky.

Rubble said, "Zuma! He's really good 
at keeping secrets, isn't he?"

[P3] MaoMao took Chase to the park.
"The wind is too strong! We should leave and find the other pups!" Chase said.
MaoMao nervously replied, "No! I mean... this place is so much fun! And I
haven't got any secrets to hide..."
Suddenly, the wind got even stronger,
and it knocked the pups off the swings
onto the ground.
Bang!

[P4] In the Pet Park, all the pups
were busily preparing for the party.
Suddenly, all the lights went out!

Rocky looked out the window and said in surprise:
"The streetlights are out too. What's going on?"

Ryder looked at his tablet and said: "If it's a city-wide blackout, it must be the wind turbine on Jack Mountain that's having problems."

"No electricity means we can't play music!" said Chase.

"And no lights! We can't have a birthday party for Marshall!" said Rubble sadly.

[P5] Ryder said, "Mighty, use your ladder to get me up to the tower."
Mighty quickly raised his ladder, allowing Ryder to climb up to the tower.
Ryder watched the remote monitoring screen. "It looks like one of the wind turbines' blades is broken. That's why we're having a blackout."
"No way! Pups, to the tower, now!" Ryder said, gripping his tablet.
The pups rushed toward the tower, but it was also without power—the elevator wasn't working.

[P6] "Pups, we've got an emergency. Rocky, I need you to find the tools to fix the wind turbine blades in the truck," Ryder said.
"Rubble, we're going to use your ladder to climb the wind turbine."
"Chase, the traffic lights are probably out too. We need you to use your siren and megaphone to direct traffic!"
PAW Patrol —
To the rescue!
Ryder whispered, "Skye, Rubble, and Marshall, you stay behind and prepare the party." The pups nodded happily.
"Let's go!" the other pups called out.

[P7] Rubble, Zuma, and Marshall stayed at the tower.
Rubble said, “Let’s go prepare the party now!”
Marshall asked, “Without electricity, what can we do?”
“We can have a party in the dark!” Zuma said.
Rubble cheered, “Right! Let’s give Chase the most special pitch-black birthday party ever!”

[P8] On Central Street, the traffic lights had no power and couldn't be used, causing the whole street to become jammed and impassable!

Mayor Goodway was very worried: "It's getting darker and darker, and we can't even cross the street!"

At that moment, Chase arrived. He immediately used his megaphone to direct traffic.

Chase shouted: "Everyone, pay attention! All pedestrians, this way, quickly! All vehicles, that way, stop!"

All the vehicles followed Chase's directions. In no time, traffic became smooth again, and pedestrians could safely cross the street.

[P9] Ryder, Marshall, and Rocky arrived at the wind turbine.
“We need to get the generator running again quickly, so that Archie’s birthday party can go on smoothly,” Ryder said, as he removed the damaged turbine blade.
Rocky said, “We can use Rubble’s old surfboard to fix it! Don’t throw away old things—they’re still useful!”
Marshall set up the ladder, and Rocky climbed up. Rocky attached the old surfboard to the turbine, and as the wind grew stronger, the turbine started spinning again.
“We did it!” Ryder, Marshall, and Rocky cheered.

[P10] In the Pet Park, when the lights came back on, the pups were happily playing.
"Ryder and the pups did it!" 
Katie cheered happily.
"But we don't have time to bake the birthday cake!" 
Toby was worried.
"I have an idea!" Katie said mysteriously.

[P11] The traffic lights on Central Street lit up again.
"Ryder and the pups succeeded! Everyone can now cross the street safely by looking at the signals," Chase said.
"Thank you, Chase!" the people on the street said.

Just then, Ryder called: "Chase, the plan has changed. We need you to head to Katie's house immediately."
"On my way!" Chase replied.
Ryder told Skye: "Chase is on his way. We're heading back too."
Skye called out: "Great! The surprise party is all ready!"

[P12] When Chase arrived at Katie's Pet Park, the room was pitch black.
"Hey, is anyone here?" Chase called out.
"Yay!" Everyone cheered, jumping out from behind the table. "Happy birthday, Chase!"
"You guys planned a birthday party for me in the dark?" Chase said excitedly.
"For surprises, call the Paw Patrol!" Ryder said with a big smile.

[P13] Katie said, "We couldn't prepare a real birthday cake for you, but I hope you like this dog biscuit cake!"
Ryder said, "It's Chase's birthday, but you're all the best pups! Let's start celebrating!"
Chase blew out the candles, and all the pups cheered. They happily ate this special birthday cake.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《冒险湾停电了》，属于《汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书》系列，由美国尼克儿童频道著，安东尼译，天地出版社出版。画面中主角狗狗穿着警服，背景是停电后用手电筒照明的派对场景。
[P2] 狗狗们在凯蒂的宠物乐园里计划为阿奇举办生日惊喜派对，讨论需要彩带和蛋糕，并思考如何不让阿奇发现准备过程。
[P3] 毛毛带阿奇到公园，阿奇因风大想离开，毛毛想留下，但突然大风将他们从秋千上刮倒。
[P4] 在宠物乐园里，狗狗们正在为阿奇的生日派对做准备时，突然全城停电。灰灰发现街灯也灭了，莱德通过平板电脑判断可能是杰克山的风力发电机故障，天天和小砾担心无法举办派对。
[P5] 莱德通过监控发现风力发电机叶片损坏导致停电，命令汪汪队前往塔台集合，但塔台也因停电导致电梯无法使用。
[P6] 莱德指挥汪汪队分工行动：灰灰负责找工具，毛毛用云梯爬风车，阿奇指挥交通，同时安排天天、小砾和路马留守准备派对，其他队员立即出发执行任务。
[P7] 在塔台，天天、小砾和路马讨论如何在停电的情况下为阿奇准备生日派对，他们决定举办一场特别的“乌漆墨黑生日派对”。
[P8] 在停电导致交通混乱的中央大街上，古威市长担忧无法通行，阿奇赶到后用扩音器指挥交通，很快恢复了秩序。
[P9] 莱德、毛毛和灰灰在风车旁修复损坏的风力发电机，灰灰用路马的旧冲浪板作为修补材料，最终成功让风车重新运转，恢复了电力供应。
[P10] 电力恢复后，宠物乐园的灯光重新亮起，狗狗们正在欢乐玩耍。凯蒂欢呼庆祝成功，但天天担心来不及做生日蛋糕，凯蒂则神秘地表示自己有个主意。
[P11] 电力恢复后，中央大街的交通信号灯重新亮起，阿奇指挥交通获得市民感谢。莱德随即通知阿奇前往凯蒂家，同时告知天天阿奇正在赶回，天天兴奋地宣布惊喜派对已准备就绪。
[P12] 阿奇抵达凯蒂的宠物乐园，发现屋内漆黑，众人突然从桌子后跳出来为他庆祝生日，阿奇惊喜万分，莱德则笑着说‘要惊喜，就找汪汪队！’
[P13] 在宠物乐园，凯蒂为阿奇准备了狗狗饼干蛋糕，莱德鼓励大家庆祝，阿奇吹灭蜡烛后，所有狗狗开心地享用蛋糕，生日派对圆满结束。
